fit_reason: Makes power distribution and assemblies, circuit protection, power quality and power reliability equipment, which is the grid-to-rack chain this sub-sector needs. Electrical segments are the core of the business and it is one of the largest suppliers in the category.

Sells breakers, medium-voltage switchgear, transformers, UPS, power distribution and prefabricated modules, with a data center solutions line covering critical power and IT power distribution. Covers nearly every item in the Electrical entry and is one of the leading data center electrical vendors.

Pure-play data center infrastructure supplier of AC and DC power management, integrated rack and modular systems, and UPS (Liebert, NetSure, Powerbar). Distributes and conditions power inside the site, and is a top vendor to hyperscale builds.

Builds switchgear, medium-voltage circuit breakers, power control room substations, bus duct and enclosures. Central to the business, though end markets lean toward oil, gas, LNG and utilities, with data centers a smaller share.

Electrification segment sells modular substation packages, switchgear, UPS, circuit breakers and wiring, and it lists data centers as a customer. Electrical equipment is a meaningful but not majority part of a diversified automation group, and it is a major global supplier.

Grid Technologies makes transformers, HVDC systems, high-voltage substations, switchgear and circuit breakers, which map to the longest-lead-time items in the entry. Gas Services (turbines, which belong to Power) is a large share, so grid equipment is only part of the business.

Electrification segment supplies grid infrastructure and power conversion, while the Power segment (turbines) belongs to Power. Grid equipment is a meaningful part of a business dominated by generation, and it is a major player in large transformers and switchgear.

Largest specialty contractor for electric transmission, distribution and substation construction, including commercial and industrial wiring and the substations and lines for renewable projects. Installing the electrical infrastructure is the core of its business.

Makes electrical products and utility transmission, distribution and substation components plus wiring and connectors. Electrical and utility equipment are its whole business, though its description does not mention data centers.
Electrical contractor for data centers and industrial sites that also manufactures custom metal-enclosed bus duct and generator enclosures. Installation and bus duct are central to what it does.

Makes enclosures, cabinets, sub-racks and electrical connection and protection products, and sells through data center installation specialists. Electrical connection is a meaningful part of the business alongside thermal management and fastening.

Makes modular DC-DC converters and power components, and the rack-level power conversion is where 800 V DC designs add content. Power conversion is its entire business, though the description does not name data centers.

Energy Systems segment sells UPS, switchgear and integrated power solutions for data center and telecom customers, plus thermally managed cabinets. The stored-energy business behind UPS is a meaningful part, but industrial batteries make up much of the company.

Infrastructure Solutions makes custom switchgear, medium and high voltage bus ducts and protective electrical enclosures. About half the business is metal coating and galvanizing, so electrical equipment is a meaningful part.
Smart Infrastructure segment sells electrification products, electrical equipment and grid products. Electrical gear is one segment of a much larger automation and industrial group.
Industrial segment sells transformers, UPS, breakers, switches and inverters, and the company also runs power grids. Electrical equipment is a small part of a very diversified conglomerate.

Electrical contractor building transmission lines, substations and distribution systems, plus commercial and industrial wiring including data centers. Installing electrical infrastructure is the whole business, though it leans toward utilities.

Electrical and mechanical construction contractor covering power distribution systems and facilities services. Electrical installation is a meaningful part of a business that is also mechanical and facilities services, and the description does not mention data centers.
Mechanical and electrical installation contractor, with electrical as one of two segments. A meaningful part is power installation, but HVAC and mechanical work dominates.

Makes standby generators up to 3,250 kW that serve as emergency backup for data centers, plus alternators and transfer controls. Backup generation is a major product, but most sales are residential and light commercial.
Makes standby and primary power generators with paralleling systems and transfer switches. The Power Systems segment is a meaningful part of a business centered on engines for vehicles.

Contract manufacturer that also sells full power solutions including switchgear, busway and power distribution units, plus server power supplies. Power products are a small part of a large manufacturing services business.

Distributor of electrical apparatus, wire and cable, transformers and transmission and distribution hardware to contractors and utilities. Distribution captures spending on electrical equipment but makes none of it.

Grid segment sells power quality systems, grid interconnection and transmission and distribution solutions, including D-VAR voltage control. Grid equipment is a meaningful part of a small company with a Wind segment.

Designs gallium nitride and silicon carbide power chips used in data center power conversion. Data centers are one of several markets for a small chip company, but the power chips in rack-level conversion are named in the entry.
Makes power conversion systems and DC-DC products, including distributed power for servers. Most revenue is plasma power for semiconductor equipment, so data center power is a smaller part.

Industrial Systems makes alternators for prime and standby power in data centers and switchgear. Electrical power products are a small part of a business that is mostly motors and mechanical power transmission.

Builds electrical transmission lines, internal wiring and cabling, and makes electrical control panels. Electrical installation is a meaningful part of a construction and utility infrastructure business.
Infrastructure contractor with a Power Delivery segment that builds electrical transmission and distribution systems. Power delivery is one segment among communications, pipelines and clean energy.
Electronic Instruments sells power quality monitoring, metering and uninterruptible power supplies. Power equipment is a small part of a diversified instruments maker.
Utilities segment installs electrical transmission and distribution systems alongside gas and pipelines. Electrical work is a smaller part of a diversified contractor.

Makes circuit protection, power control and power conversion components, with data centers one of many end markets. Circuit protection is a meaningful business, but most of the company serves other markets such as vehicles and industrial.
Makes high-voltage power conversion chips and gate drivers, including for high-voltage DC transmission. Computing is a small part of a business weighted to consumer chargers and appliances.
